concerns.text: Task T008 depends on descriptor space that is only generated in T011 (Feature Engineering). Since T011 is scheduled later, T008 cannot be executed as written. Add an explicit prerequisite or reorder phases so that descriptor calculation occurs before split generation.

Task T009 references a 'local proxy client (T012)' which does not exist; T012 is the Model Training script. The proxy client is undefined, making the task unexecutable. Define a proxy client task (e.g., T013) or correct the reference.
T009 also requires descriptor‑space distances from the training centroid, which are unavailable until T011 runs. Reorder or add a dependency on T011.

Task T018 assumes that variance distribution from 10 independent RF models (seeds 0‑9) is already generated inside T012, but T012 only saves the best model and does not produce these variance artifacts. Either extend T012 to generate and output the variance distribution or add a new task to compute it.

Task T005 is still unchecked; the verification requires at least one passed test per file, but no test implementations are provided in the current repository. Ensure that placeholder test modules contain at least one passing test each, or adjust the verification criteria.
